name: Horizon Therapeutic Massage and Wellness
description: Private therapeutic massage studio in downtown Penn Yan offering relaxation and targeted bodywork. Therapist Laurie is highly praised by clients for professional, attentive, and effective massage.

name: Peak Performance Therapeutic Massage
description: Licensed massage therapist Jackie Bauda offers deep tissue, Swedish, hot stone, sports, trigger point, myofascial release, and reflexology massage in Penn Yan. Gift certificates available.

name: Body Dynamics Massage Therapy
description: Therapeutic massage practice at 165 Main Street, Penn Yan, open weekdays. Therapist Suzanne is known for professional sessions that clients describe as restorative.

name: Knapp and Co. Salon & Day Spa
description: Downtown Penn Yan day spa and salon offering facials, chemical peels, Reiki, Raindrop essential-oil treatments, acupuncture, and full hair and beauty services. Listed by the Yates County Chamber of Commerce under Health, Wellness & Personal Care.

name: Polishing Touches
description: Full-service Penn Yan salon offering facials, waxing, massage therapy, manicures, pedicures, and tanning in a spa-like atmosphere.

name: ZaZen Massage
hoursNote: By appointment only; call or text to book
description: Boutique massage studio on Route 54 at the south tip of Keuka Lake offering Thai, hot stone, CBD-infused, Lomi Lomi, and reflexology massage plus an infrared sauna. Owner-therapist Chameil Haney, LMT, also maintains a local artisan boutique on site.

name: Keuka Peaceful Roots
hoursNote: By appointment for massage; contact for class schedules
description: Community wellness center in downtown Hammondsport offering yoga classes, guided meditation, therapeutic massage, bodywork, somatic healing, and Taiji for all ages and ability levels.

name: The Black Sheep Inn and Spa
hoursNote: Spa by appointment; book when reserving room or at least 72 hours in advance
description: Historic 19th-century octagon house B&B on the outskirts of Hammondsport offering Swedish, hot stone, and deep tissue massage by licensed therapists in a tranquil vegan-friendly inn. Spa services are available to guests and can be booked with accommodations.
